```yaml
name: Regenerate Sonar API spec

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'  # 06:00 UTC daily
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  regenerate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: pnpm-lock.yaml

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm@9.4.0

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Authenticate as octavia-bot
        uses: octavia-bot/github-app-auth@v1
        id: auth
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          permissions: contents:write,pull_requests:write

      - name: Run prepare-embedded-api-spec.js
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.auth.outputs.token }}
        run: node scripts/prepare-embedded-api-spec.js

      - name: Format spec with prettier
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.auth.outputs.token }}
        run: pnpm prettier --write docs/api/**/*.json

      - name: Check for changes
        id: changes
        run: |
          if ! git diff --quiet; then
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit changes
        if: steps.changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.auth.outputs.token }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "octavia-bot"
          git config user.email "octavia-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
          git checkout -b regenerate-sonar-api-spec
          git add docs/api/**/*.json
          git commit -m "chore: regenerate Sonar API spec"
          git push origin regenerate-sonar-api-spec

      - name: Create PR
        if: steps.changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: octavia-bot/pr-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ steps.auth.outputs.token }}
          title: "chore: regenerate Sonar API spec"
          body: |
            Automated regeneration of the Sonar API spec for Docusaurus.
          head: regenerate-sonar-api-spec
          base: main
          labels: auto-merge, autogenerated, documentation
```
